page.layout: One text page: running head at top with page number at right; continuous running text above a rule; below the rule a centred title block (PROPOSITIONES EXCERPTAE, EX LIBRO, AMADAEI GUIMENII &c., DE EBRIETATE, Pag. 3. Num. 1.), then a paragraph with a large initial M; signature line "eeeee 3" at left and "Pag. 70." at right at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: falsas, improbabiles, scandalosas, temerarias & erroneas, &c. Quomodo enim scandalosae & erroneae, quas Ecclesia in tot tantisque Doctoribus, opinionibus, opiniones non corrigit &c. nullibi ergo scandalum, nullibi error. Ex quo aperte intelligitur, id praesertim hoc suo libello molitum fuisse Amadaeum, ut omnes illas propositiones ab omni censura immunes, atque externae probabilitatis munimine tutas praestaret. Cum igitur iidem deputati a Sacra Facultate Doctores, saepius inter se super illis propositionibus convenissent, notisque affectas ad Facultatem detulissent, eadem Facultas toto negotio pro more, in deliberationem per D. Decanum, in quatuordecim Comitiis generalibus misso, de praedictis propositionibus selectis & examini subjectis sic censuit.
main_text.head: PROPOSITIONES EXCERPTAE EX LIBRO AMADAEI GUIMENII &c. DE EBRIETATE
main_text.p: Mirum non est, quod hi Doctores doceant, ebrietatem esse licitam ad vitandam mortem, quando alii ad conservandam etiam salutem licere putant.

page.notes: The large initial M of "Mirum" is joined to the first word. The title block is set in spaced capitals and small italic; the "Pag. 70." line is a printed reference at the foot right. The printed "Pag. 70." and "eeeee 3" sit on one line and are kept as printed.
